notes: Basis: governmental funds are labelled 'modified cash basis' (manifest) but the fund statements print a fund-balance roll-forward, so basis GAAP is used with fund balances: 990,322.47 + restated (253,130.23) + revenues 4,577,822.91 - expenditures 4,077,447.45 + transfers in 45,787.98 - transfers out 45,787.98 = 1,237,567.70. The Total Governmental Funds column nets the operating transfers to zero; the General fund (45,787.98) out and Grant fund 45,787.98 in are recorded from the fund columns on p7. Business-type funds (Electric, Water, Sewer, Waste) use the Total column of the proprietary statement (p10); 'Less: Cost of purchased power' is recorded as a disbursement; net position 13,282,531.57 + 7,789,417.28 - 7,204,137.02 = 13,867,811.83. Proprietary cash flow figures from p11-12 total column. Balance sheet is the government-wide Statement of Net Position Totals column (p1-2; includes interfund due from/to 721,456.04 on both sides as printed). Component unit (Community Development Corp) ignored. ending_cash is Cash (including cash equivalents) 1,142,592.99 from the governmental funds balance sheet p5; Cash on deposit - County Treasurer 44,488.75 is separate. Detail: only the General Fund departmental combining schedule (p14) is recorded by department column; the all-funds budgetary comparison (p13, totals by function) overlaps it and is less detailed, so it is omitted to avoid double counting. Cemetery is placed under health/welfare in detail, but the basic statement prints it within Public Works. Business-type detail: the Proprietary Funds lines (Electric, Water, Wastewater, Sanitation) of the all-funds budgetary comparison (p13) are recorded as not itemized; that schedule's revenues and totals mix governmental and business-type funds, so no business-type total entry. Recheck: Contributions split by fund column (General 33,323.04 donations/contributions; Grant 215,386.70 federal grants) and Public Works split by fund column (Street 610,769.87 streets/highways; General/Cemetery 240,905.71 health/welfare), p6. Read pages 1-14 of 14. Detail (user 2026-10-27): per-fund lines from the fund statements' columns (p6-7, p10) added for the funds that had no schedule. The General Fund departmental schedule (p14) ties to the General column and is kept (fund renamed General Fund); the all-funds budgetary comparison's proprietary lines (p13) are replaced by the proprietary statement's fund columns.
